item.title: Agent-Based Modelling for Social Network Research
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on agent-based modelling approaches applied to the study of social networks. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how computational simulation methods can illuminate the formation, evolution, and dynamics of social networks across various contexts and disciplines.

Appel publié par Social Networks. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Agent-based modelling applications in social network research
  • Computational simulation of social processes
  • Network dynamics and emergence
  • Social behavior modeling
  • Interdisciplinary approaches to network analysis

Timeline

  • December 15, 2026: Submission deadline
